name: commit_and_push
description: Commit every change in the worktree with the given message and push the branch. Use a Conventional Commit message (feat(scope): ..., fix: ...). Make small, focused commits: call it after each coherent piece of work. When the work is done, pass `pull_request` to open (or update) the pull request in this same call, after the same check `open_pull_request` requires; leave it out to commit only, or to open the pull request later with `open_pull_request`. With several repositories in the workspace, say which with `repo`. In a scratch project it only commits, locally: nothing is pushed.

pull_request.description: The pull request to open (or update) after the push, in this same call. Leave it out to commit only.

accept_red_checks.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly said, in this conversation, that a pull request with failing (or no) checks is acceptable. Never set it on your own judgement.

repo.description: The slot to commit and push: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.
